By introducing a corrupted-checklist control, we isolate the causal role of rule correctness. If the panel's accuracy drops significantly when using the corrupted checklist on divergence cases, the rules themselves are doing epistemic work, confirming genuine reliability.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
